title: A Halfling's Greed
summary: Clear the chest guards and open the treasures in the correct order.
overview: Clear the chest guards and open the treasures in the correct order.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Inspect the chests and clear their guards before committing to an opening.
The required opening order is gold, cracked, gilded, then silver.
Opening a later chest while an earlier one remains triggers Meddler's Misfortune and ends the mission.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
